behavior: Native entry runs through the actual member screen,canonical member check,selected salon,directory action and owned invitation controller.
Sharing a one-hour recipient code requires per-code consent; host review and approval never join the recipient.
Native account/provider/member/salon are freshly checked before each operation; confirmation is a separate action.
Private names,codes and unsent review clear on background,Android blur,offline,account retirement and disconnect. Earlier form/confirmation callbacks cannot act on a newer review.
A sent join retains only its account-bound read-only receipt reference in the same retained controller. Recovery never resends a join; another account cannot load it.
Uncertain revocation retains only the original request/revisions and requires deliberate review/confirmation before its exact retry. Members remain.
Explicit native discard removes the retained controller and returns to the real member screen. Recovery does not survive app termination,new controller or explicit discard.
Quest mounts the form only after explicit Connect. The per-view activity boundary pauses synchronously when XR permission is requested,before awaiting the headset.

Quest entry/exit/blur/offline requires an explicit fresh account/access check; there is no automatic invitation request. Account selection change or disconnect ends that connected form and discards its receipt reference.
Phone review hides earlier entry forms while presenting the account,recipient,effects and community norms.

rejectedEvidence.reason: Earlier runner could write PASS after a failed timing assertion because WASM database cleanup reset process.exitCode. Its nonempty failure field makes that receipt unusable. Replaced by an owned failure flag,an explicit render-state wait,negative calibration,and the sealed runs.
